resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1921 newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts says a station had been in use on Mount Henry for a number of years, while firelookout.com dates the first cabin to 1926. Both are reported in the story; neither source explains the gap.

notes_for_editor: Record id -2 is the Missoula County Mount Henry near Seeley Lake (Lolo NF, 47.24986 -113.61674). It is a different lookout from us-mt-mount-henry (Lincoln County, Kootenai NF, NHLR US 346), so keep the two stories apart. The brief's design, height, agency, gone status and coordinates all match the sources; no correction proposed. Only one source (firelookout.com) gives the 1926 cabin and the 1952 destruction date, and the 1921 item conflicts with the 1926 date. No source describes the site today or whether it is open, so the access key is omitted.
